title: Saltwater Society | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to Saltwater Society, a charming and thoughtfully designed condo retreat where beach days, poolside relaxation, and easygoing comfort come together effortlessly. Sleeping up to 6 guests, this cozy getaway is ideal for small families, couples, or friends looking to experience the best of beach living while enjoying all the comforts of home. Inside, the condo features a bright and inviting open layout with stylish coastal décor, comfortable furnishings, and smartly designed spaces that make relaxing easy. The bunk beds provide a fun and practical sleeping setup for kids or additional guests, while the rest of the space is designed to feel welcoming, functional, and comfortable after a day in the sun. Whether you're preparing a quick breakfast before heading to the beach or winding down after a sunset stroll, the studio has everything needed for a carefree vacation stay. One of the best parts of this home is the unbeatable location. Beach access is less than a two-minute walk away at the end of the street, making it effortless to spend your days enjoying the sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters. Start your mornings with coffee and a peaceful walk to the beach, spend the afternoon swimming and soaking up the sun, then return home to relax by the community pool. For guests looking to explore the area, the home also includes two adult bikes, perfect for cruising through the neighborhood, discovering nearby shops and restaurants, or enjoying scenic rides along the coast. The combination of beach access, bike rides, and poolside afternoons creates the perfect balance of relaxation and adventure. Located in the heart of Inlet Beach, Saltwater Society puts you minutes from award-winning restaurants and shops, and to the best of 30A’s coastal charm. All just a short walk from the vibrant energy of 30Avenure and Rosemary Beach. Whether you're planning a weekend getaway, a family beach trip, or a longer coastal stay, this studio retreat offers everything you need for a memorable vacation. With comfortable accommodations, convenient amenities, and the beach just steps away, it’s the perfect place to slow down, unwind, and enjoy the laid-back charm of the coast. **Condo is located on the second floor. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Less than 2 minute walk to the Gulf- Inlet Beach Access -Private gated community -Bunk bed -2 adult bikes -1 dedicated parking spot -Wrap around porch -30Avenue -Steps from Rosemary Beach ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 6 Bedroom: King (Private Room) Built-In Twin/Twin Bunks Sleeper Sofa BEACH ACCESS Two access points, just a short walk from the home: 1. Inlet Beach Public Access. This access has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located at the end of South Orange Street about two minute walk from the home. Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access and features three dune walkovers and 117 parking spaces. 2. Wall Street Beach Public Access. This access is at the end of South Wall Street. About 200 yards east of the intersection of Scenic 30A and Hwy 98, turn south on to South Wall Street then proceed two blocks to the dead end at the gulf. There is no parking but there is plenty of parking, along with restrooms and outdoor showers about 1/4 mile east at the Inlet Beach Access. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING One parking space available in private gated community (Parking Lot). No street parking allowed. Included are 2 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *The home must remain pet free to the rules. *There are no refunds for weather related events. We advise trip insurance during hurricane season (May-November) IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Other things to note
